//: Story Phase 4: things to look at and poke, and the Dead Center's door warning. Map objects in data/maps/ship/phase4 and data/maps/ship/washroom.json point here.
hazard.dead_center_door: The door won't budge. Something warm and heavy is leaning on the other side of it.
A thin yellow light shows round the edges. The Dead Center is in {deadCenter}.
captain[resigned]: Not in there. Not until it moves on.
p4.forecast_board: The Forecast Board. A crayon cloud painted at the top, and underneath it every forecast the Grand Stenchmaster has ever made, pinned up in order.

then: The breakfast table is somewhere inside the Center. So is the forecast, and your breakfast, and Bob's good biscuit.
else: The long table where the crew take their ration. Somebody has carved WHERE IS IT TODAY into the end of it.

then: Garrick pins a copy of every forecast to the table leg, too, for people who can't face the walk to the board.

p4.inspect.bell_1: The ship's bell. It has a greenish crust round the rim now, and when the wind catches it, it wheezes.
captain[tired]: Once, this bell rang the watches. Now it clears its throat.
You consider ringing it. Twenty men would throw themselves overboard. You don't.
p4.inspect.bell_2: You tap the bell with one finger, very gently.
It goes 'klang', very quietly, and then 'hk'.
Across the deck, three heads turn round with their eyes very wide.
captain: ...Nothing! Nothing. That wasn't a bell. Carry on.
p4.inspect.bell_3: Quill's protocol is nailed up beside it. Somebody has added a fifth line underneath, in charcoal: FIVE: GARRICK HAS HAD BEANS. ABANDON SHIP.

p4.inspect.bell_notice.caption: The bell protocol, in Quill's neat hand.

p4.inspect.grog_cask_1: The Frog Grog cask. It has started to creak on its own, like a ship does in a swell.
captain[disgusted]: It's aging. Garrick says that's a good thing. Garrick says a lot of things.
p4.inspect.grog_cask_2: Mags has chalked a notice on the lid: RATION ONE PER HEAD. DO NOT STIR. IT DOESN'T LIKE IT.
p4.inspect.grog_cask_3: You lift the lid an inch. The surface of the Frog Grog has a skin on it, and the skin has a shine on it, and the shine has a sort of rainbow that isn't a rainbow.
A single bubble comes up, looks at you, and goes back down.
p4.inspect.hammock: A hammock. It sways gently, though the ship is steady, and every so often it sighs.

then: It's been sitting in the Center all night. It smells the way the Center smells, only more personal.

p4.inspect.hammock: captain[disgusted]: Jory said they were 'reactivating'. I'm not lying down in anything that reactivates.
p4.inspect.wash_basin: A tin basin, and a jug of seawater, and a cracked mirror on a nail.

then: Gristle's toothbrush is gone. He took it with him, through the scuttle. He hasn't let go of it since.

p4.inspect.wash_basin: You look in the mirror. The beard looks back. It has never once, in all this time, looked sorry.
p4.inspect.wash_tub: The washroom tub, big enough for a man, or one very determined beard.

then: The water has gone faintly yellow. So has the soap. So has the lemon.
captain[tired]: Refreshed. It's REFRESHED. I scrubbed it with everything we own and it came out refreshed.
else: captain[tired]: Seawater. Soap. Lemons. Vinegar. Sand. Smoke. Herbs. One at a time, every one of them. Nothing.

p4.inspect.remedies_list.caption: The captain's list. Garrick has been at it with a crayon.

p4.inspect.remedies_list: captain[resigned]: 'Molecular beard level.' He signed it.
p4.inspect.remedy_shelf: A shelf of everything you've ever tried on the beard. Seawater in a bottle. A cake of soap worn to a sliver. Lemon rinds. Vinegar. A jar of sand. A bundle of Doc Fennimore's herbs, half burned.
All of it smells, very faintly, of beard.
p4.inspect.washroom_vent: A little grated vent near the ceiling. Somewhere up there is the air scuttle on deck.

then: There's a small tuft of Gristle's shirt still caught on it.
else: The Center likes this vent. Everybody else is scared of it.

then: The air scuttle over the washroom. Somebody has put the grating back on, and nailed a sign beside it: GRISTLE WAS HERE. (TWELVE MINUTES.)
else: A small grated scuttle in the deck, letting a little air down into the washroom below. It is the least popular breathing hole on the ship.

p4.inspect.stovepipe: The galley stovepipe, with its damper handle halfway up.

then: Jim has tied a label to the handle: CAPTAIN'S DAMPER. FOR EMERGENCIES. (ALL OF THEM.)

p4.inspect.biscuits: Ship's biscuit. It has gone faintly yellow round the edges, down here near the treasure room.

then: Squawks's nest: a coil of rope and a folded blanket. Seven feathers have been laid out along the edge of it, very neatly, in a row.
Nobody has moved them. Nobody is going to.
Squawks's nest: a coil of rope and a folded blanket. There's a tally scratched into the plank beside it: three lines. Somebody has been counting feathers.
else: Squawks's nest: a coil of rope and a folded blanket, and one very small golden feather's worth of pride.

p4.inspect.basket: Squawks's padded basket: an old hat box, a cushion and his blanket.

then: It's empty but for a knitted cap. He's out, being bald somewhere with dignity.
else: He's been sleeping in it with his head under his wing, protecting the new feathers.

p4.inspect.patches: The port rail, and the hull below it. Every plank has been patched at least once. Most have been patched for the patches.
There are bite marks on the chalk.
p4.inspect.duty_barrel: The Shark Duty barrel: two poles, a boathook, a paddle, a mop and a broom. Every handle has a bite mark near the far end.

then: Jory keeps the roster. If you ever feel like a shift, it's him you'd ask. Nobody ever feels like a shift.

p4.inspect.helm: The wheel. It answers the helm again, mostly, though it pulls a little to port where the sharks have been at the rudder.
Nell has tied a piece of yellow ribbon to one spoke, so she can tell by feel if the Center has been sitting on it.
p4.jory_duty_offer: jory: Want a shift on the rail, Captain? There's always someone out there chewing.

then: jory[happy]: Right you are. Pole's in the barrel. Just talk to me when you've had enough.
jory: Stood down. Good work. They'll be back, mind. They always are.

p4.stench_log_stand: The Stench Log, open on its stand. Someone has drawn a small crayon shark in the margin.
